shop_id.description: The unique positive non-zero numeric ID for an Etsy Shop.
shop_id.title: Shop Id

quantity.description: The positive non-zero number of products available for purchase in the listing. Note: The listing quantity is the sum of available offering quantities. You can request the quantities for individual offerings from the ListingInventory resource using the [getListingInventory](/documentation/reference#operation/getListingInventory) endpoint.
quantity.title: Quantity

title.description: The listing's title string. When creating or updating a listing, valid title strings contain only letters, numbers, punctuation marks, mathematical symbols, whitespace characters, ™, ©, and ®. (regex: /[^\p{L}\p{Nd}\p{P}\p{Sm}\p{Zs}™©®]/u) You can only use the %, :, & and + characters once each.
title.title: Title

description.description: A description string of the product for sale in the listing.
description.title: Description

price.description: The positive non-zero price of the product. (Sold product listings are private) Note: The price is the minimum possible price. The [`getListingInventory`](/documentation/reference/#operation/getListingInventory) method requests exact prices for available offerings.
price.title: Price

who_made.description: An enumerated string indicating who made the product. Helps buyers locate the listing under the Handmade heading. Requires 'is_supply' and 'when_made'.
who_made.title: Who Made

when_made.description: An enumerated string for the era in which the maker made the product in this listing. Helps buyers locate the listing under the Vintage heading. Requires 'is_supply' and 'who_made'.
when_made.title: When Made

taxonomy_id.description: The numerical taxonomy ID of the listing. See [SellerTaxonomy](/documentation/reference#tag/SellerTaxonomy) and [BuyerTaxonomy](/documentation/reference#tag/BuyerTaxonomy) for more information.
taxonomy_id.title: Taxonomy Id

shipping_profile_id.description: The numeric ID of the [shipping profile](/documentation/reference#operation/getShopShippingProfile) associated with the listing. Required when listing type is `physical`.
shipping_profile_id.title: Shipping Profile Id

materials.description: A list of material strings for materials used in the product. Valid materials strings contain only letters, numbers, and whitespace characters. (regex: /[^\p{L}\p{Nd}\p{Zs}]/u) Default value is null.
materials.title: Materials

shop_section_id.description: The numeric ID of the [shop section](/documentation/reference#tag/Shop-Section) for this listing. Default value is null.
shop_section_id.title: Shop Section Id

processing_min.description: The minimum number of days required to process this listing. Default value is null.
processing_min.title: Processing Min

processing_max.description: The maximum number of days required to process this listing. Default value is null.
processing_max.title: Processing Max

readiness_state_id.description: The numeric ID of the [processing profile](/documentation/reference#operation/getShopReadinessStateDefinition) associated with the listing. Returned only when the listing is `active` and of type `physical`, and the endpoint is either shop-scoped (path contains `shop_id`) or a single-listing request such as `getListing`. For every other case this field can be null.
readiness_state_id.title: Readiness State Id

tags.description: A comma-separated list of tag strings for the listing. When creating or updating a listing, valid tag strings contain only letters, numbers, whitespace characters, -, ', ™, ©, and ®. (regex: /[^\p{L}\p{Nd}\p{Zs}\-'™©®]/u) Default value is null.
tags.title: Tags

styles.description: An array of style strings for this listing, each of which is free-form text string such as "Formal", or "Steampunk". When creating or updating a listing, the listing may have up to two styles. Valid style strings contain only letters, numbers, and whitespace characters. (regex: /[^\p{L}\p{Nd}\p{Zs}]/u) Each style string is limited to 45 characters. Default value is null.
styles.title: Styles

item_weight.description: The numeric weight of the product measured in units set in 'item_weight_unit'. Default value is null. If set, the value must be greater than 0.
item_weight.title: Item Weight

item_length.description: The numeric length of the product measured in units set in 'item_dimensions_unit'. Default value is null. If set, the value must be greater than 0.
item_length.title: Item Length

item_width.description: The numeric width of the product measured in units set in 'item_dimensions_unit'. Default value is null. If set, the value must be greater than 0.
item_width.title: Item Width

item_height.description: The numeric height of the product measured in units set in 'item_dimensions_unit'. Default value is null. If set, the value must be greater than 0.
item_height.title: Item Height

item_weight_unit.description: A string defining the units used to measure the weight of the product. Default value is null.
item_weight_unit.title: Item Weight Unit

item_dimensions_unit.description: A string defining the units used to measure the dimensions of the product. Default value is null.
item_dimensions_unit.title: Item Dimensions Unit

production_partner_ids.description: An array of unique IDs of production partner ids.
production_partner_ids.title: Production Partner Ids

image_ids.description: An array of numeric image IDs of the images in a listing, which can include up to 20 images.
image_ids.title: Image Ids

ecgt_garan_brand.description: The brand or trademark name for the EU commercial guarantee (required under GPSR/ECGT for eligible EU traders). Maximum 25 characters. See the [Etsy Seller Handbook](https://help.etsy.com/hc/articles/43191692248343) for details. If any one of ecgt_garan_brand, ecgt_garan_model, ecgt_garan_years, or ecgt_garan_guarantee_details is provided and non-empty, all four are required. Silently ignored for digital listings and for sellers who are not eligible EU traders.
ecgt_garan_brand.title: Ecgt Garan Brand

ecgt_garan_years.description: Duration of the EU commercial guarantee in whole years (minimum 3, maximum 99). Required together with ecgt_garan_brand, ecgt_garan_model, and ecgt_garan_guarantee_details. Silently ignored for digital listings and for sellers who are not eligible EU traders.
ecgt_garan_years.title: Ecgt Garan Years

ecgt_garan_model.description: The product model or reference number for the EU commercial guarantee label. Maximum 20 characters. Required together with ecgt_garan_brand, ecgt_garan_years, and ecgt_garan_guarantee_details. Silently ignored for digital listings and for sellers who are not eligible EU traders.
ecgt_garan_model.title: Ecgt Garan Model

ecgt_garan_guarantee_details.description: Free-text description of the EU commercial guarantee terms and coverage. Maximum 255 characters. Required together with ecgt_garan_brand, ecgt_garan_model, and ecgt_garan_years. Silently ignored for digital listings and for sellers who are not eligible EU traders.
ecgt_garan_guarantee_details.title: Ecgt Garan Guarantee Details

ecgt_other_commercial_guarantee_details.description: Free-text details of any additional commercial guarantee or warranty beyond the primary EU commercial guarantee. Maximum 255 characters. Silently ignored for digital listings and for sellers who are not eligible EU traders.
ecgt_other_commercial_guarantee_details.title: Ecgt Other Commercial Guarantee Details

ecgt_after_sales_service_info.description: After-sales service, repairability, or eco-friendly delivery information required under EU GPSR/ECGT regulations. Maximum 255 characters. Silently ignored for digital listings and for sellers who are not eligible EU traders.
ecgt_after_sales_service_info.title: Ecgt After Sales Service Info

ecgt_software_update_details.description: Details of software update availability and the duration of such updates, as required under EU ECGT regulations for digital content. Maximum 255 characters. Silently ignored for physical listings and for sellers who are not eligible EU traders.
ecgt_software_update_details.title: Ecgt Software Update Details

gpsr_manufacturer_type.description: Who the manufacturer of this product is, for GPSR (EU General Product Safety Regulation) purposes. Either `seller` (your shop is the manufacturer) or `economic_operator` (a manufacturer record from the [Shop Economic Operators](/documentation/reference#tag/Shop-Economic-Operators) endpoints, identified by `gpsr_manufacturer_id`). `seller` is rejected when `who_made` is `someone_else`; use `economic_operator` for items made by a third party. Send `null` to clear. Optional for now; it becomes required for listings from eligible traders that sell into the EU 60 days after these fields were announced. See the [GPSR Economic Operators Tutorial](/documentation/tutorials/gpsr-economic-operators) for eligibility and the full flow.
gpsr_manufacturer_type.title: Gpsr Manufacturer Type

gpsr_manufacturer_id.description: The `economic_operator_id` of the manufacturer, from the [Shop Economic Operators](/documentation/reference#tag/Shop-Economic-Operators) endpoints. Required when `gpsr_manufacturer_type` is `economic_operator`, and rejected when the type is anything else. The operator must belong to this shop and not be deleted. The manufacturer may be located anywhere in the world. If you change `gpsr_manufacturer_type` to `seller` without sending this field, the stored id is cleared for you.
gpsr_manufacturer_id.title: Gpsr Manufacturer Id

gpsr_responsible_person_type.description: Who the EU responsible person for this product is, for GPSR purposes. Either `seller` (your shop; only valid when the shop's legal address, or the address on file, is in the European Union) or `economic_operator` (a record from the [Shop Economic Operators](/documentation/reference#tag/Shop-Economic-Operators) endpoints, identified by `gpsr_responsible_person_id`, which must have an address in the European Union). Send `null` to clear. Optional for now; it becomes required for listings from eligible traders that sell into the EU 60 days after these fields were announced. See the [GPSR Economic Operators Tutorial](/documentation/tutorials/gpsr-economic-operators) for eligibility and the full flow.
gpsr_responsible_person_type.title: Gpsr Responsible Person Type

gpsr_responsible_person_id.description: The `economic_operator_id` of the EU responsible person, from the [Shop Economic Operators](/documentation/reference#tag/Shop-Economic-Operators) endpoints. Required when `gpsr_responsible_person_type` is `economic_operator`, and rejected when the type is anything else. The operator must belong to this shop and not be deleted, and its address must be in the European Union. If you change `gpsr_responsible_person_type` to `seller` without sending this field, the stored id is cleared for you.
gpsr_responsible_person_id.title: Gpsr Responsible Person Id

gpsr_serial_number.description: An optional serial number, batch number, or lot identifier that lets the product be traced for GPSR purposes. Maximum 255 characters. Send `null` to clear.
gpsr_serial_number.title: Gpsr Serial Number

gpsr_safety_warnings.description: Optional free-text safety warnings and safety information for the product regarding GPSR purposes, shown to buyers as product safety information on the listing page (for example age restrictions, choking hazards, or care and handling instructions). Maximum 102,400 characters. Send `null` to clear.
gpsr_safety_warnings.title: Gpsr Safety Warnings

is_supply.title: Is Supply

is_customizable.description: When true, a buyer may contact the seller for a customized order. The default value is true when a shop accepts custom orders. Does not apply to shops that do not accept custom orders.

should_auto_renew.description: When true, renews a listing for four months upon expiration.
should_auto_renew.title: Should Auto Renew

is_taxable.description: When true, applicable [shop](/documentation/reference#tag/Shop) tax rates apply to this listing at checkout.
is_taxable.title: Is Taxable

gpsr_manufacturer_type.title: Gpsr Manufacturer Type

gpsr_manufacturer_id.description: The `economic_operator_id` of the manufacturer, from the [Shop Economic Operators](/documentation/reference#tag/Shop-Economic-Operators) endpoints. Required when `gpsr_manufacturer_type` is `economic_operator`, and rejected when the type is anything else. The operator must belong to this shop and not be deleted. The manufacturer may be located anywhere in the world. If you change `gpsr_manufacturer_type` to `seller` without sending this field, the stored id is cleared for you.
gpsr_manufacturer_id.title: Gpsr Manufacturer Id

gpsr_responsible_person_type.description: Who the EU responsible person for this product is, for GPSR purposes. Either `seller` (your shop; only valid when the shop's legal address, or the address on file, is in the European Union) or `economic_operator` (a record from the [Shop Economic Operators](/documentation/reference#tag/Shop-Economic-Operators) endpoints, identified by `gpsr_responsible_person_id`, which must have an address in the European Union). Send `null` to clear. Optional for now; it becomes required for listings from eligible traders that sell into the EU 60 days after these fields were announced. See the [GPSR Economic Operators Tutorial](/documentation/tutorials/gpsr-economic-operators) for eligibility and the full flow.
gpsr_responsible_person_type.title: Gpsr Responsible Person Type

gpsr_responsible_person_id.description: The `economic_operator_id` of the EU responsible person, from the [Shop Economic Operators](/documentation/reference#tag/Shop-Economic-Operators) endpoints. Required when `gpsr_responsible_person_type` is `economic_operator`, and rejected when the type is anything else. The operator must belong to this shop and not be deleted, and its address must be in the European Union. If you change `gpsr_responsible_person_type` to `seller` without sending this field, the stored id is cleared for you.
gpsr_responsible_person_id.title: Gpsr Responsible Person Id

gpsr_serial_number.description: An optional serial number, batch number, or lot identifier that lets the product be traced for GPSR purposes. Maximum 255 characters. Send `null` to clear.
gpsr_serial_number.title: Gpsr Serial Number

gpsr_safety_warnings.description: Optional free-text safety warnings and safety information for the product regarding GPSR purposes, shown to buyers as product safety information on the listing page (for example age restrictions, choking hazards, or care and handling instructions). Maximum 102,400 characters. Send `null` to clear.
gpsr_safety_warnings.title: Gpsr Safety Warnings
